request.system:
You are the tech lead planning work for an automated implementation pipeline. Split the
specification into tasks that each fit one focused implementation attempt (a few files).

Rules:
- Every requirement id (FR-n and NFR-n) is covered by at least one task's requirementIds. Use only
  ids that exist in the spec.
- Tasks are numbered T1, T2, …; dependsOn names only earlier tasks, so the graph has no cycles.
- Database migrations are their own MIGRATION task, before the code that needs them.
- Tests are written separately from code (TEST tasks depend on the spec, not on the code tasks).
- estimatedFiles are repository-relative paths you expect to touch.
- risk is HIGH for security, data migration or public API changes, MED for behaviour changes to
  existing code, LOW otherwise.

Specification (requirements_spec):
{"problemStatement":"Link owners want to record why a link exists and to analyse clicks in a spreadsheet. Links get an optional plain-text note (at most 280 characters), set on create and returned with the link, and the owner can export the daily clicks of a link as CSV with the same range rules and owner check as the JSON stats.","functional":[{"id":"FR-1","text":"POST /api/v1/links accepts an optional note (string, at most 280 characters); a longer note is rejected with 400 and a Problem Details body of type /problems/validation-failed.","priority":"MUST"},{"id":"FR-2","text":"The link responses of create (201) and GET /api/v1/links/{code} include note: the stored text, or null when none was given.","priority":"MUST"},{"id":"FR-3","text":"GET /api/v1/links/{code}/stats.csv returns text/csv with a header row day,clicks and one row per UTC day in the range, oldest first, zero-filled.","priority":"MUST"},{"id":"FR-4","text":"The CSV export takes the same optional from/to parameters as GET /api/v1/links/{code}/stats, with the same defaults (last 30 days), maximum (90 days) and errors (400 /problems/invalid-stats-range), and the same owner check (404 /problems/link-not-found for another key's or an unknown link).","priority":"MUST"}],"nonFunctional":[{"id":"NFR-1","text":"Existing clients keep working: note is optional on create, and links created before this change have no note.","category":"COMPATIBILITY"},{"id":"NFR-2","text":"The note is returned only to the link's owner through the management API; it never appears on the public redirect.","category":"PRIVACY"}],"acceptanceCriteria":[{"id":"AC-1","requirementId":"FR-1","given":"a valid API key","when":"POST /api/v1/links with url and note \"spring campaign\"","then":"201 and the body has note \"spring campaign\""},{"id":"AC-2","requirementId":"FR-1","given":"a valid API key","when":"POST /api/v1/links with a note of 281 characters","then":"400 application/problem+json with type /problems/validation-failed"},{"id":"AC-3","requirementId":"FR-2","given":"a link created with a note","when":"GET /api/v1/links/{code}","then":"the body has the same note"},{"id":"AC-4","requirementId":"NFR-1","given":"a link created without a note","when":"GET /api/v1/links/{code}","then":"the body has note null"},{"id":"AC-5","requirementId":"FR-3","given":"a link with 2 clicks on 2026-03-02 and none on 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-03","when":"GET /api/v1/links/{code}/stats.csv?from=2026-03-01&to=2026-03-03","then":"200 text/csv with the lines day,clicks / 2026-03-01,0 / 2026-03-02,2 / 2026-03-03,0"},{"id":"AC-6","requirementId":"FR-4","given":"a link owned by the caller","when":"GET /api/v1/links/{code}/stats.csv?from=2026-03-05&to=2026-03-01","then":"400 with type /problems/invalid-stats-range"},{"id":"AC-7","requirementId":"FR-4","given":"a link owned by another API key","when":"GET /api/v1/links/{code}/stats.csv","then":"404 with type /problems/link-not-found"},{"id":"AC-8","requirementId":"NFR-2","given":"a link with a note","when":"GET /{code} (the redirect)","then":"302 to the original URL and the note is not in the response"}],"assumptions":["The note is stored as given (no trimming); an empty note is stored as an empty string.","The CSV has no other columns: unique visitors, referrers and user agents stay in the JSON stats.","Notes cannot be changed after creation; there is no update endpoint for links today."],"ambiguities":[{"id":"AMB-1","question":"Should the CSV be offered as a download (Content-Disposition attachment)?","options":["inline text/csv","attachment with a file name"],"severity":"NONBLOCKING","proposedDefault":"attachment named <code>-clicks.csv, so browsers save it for the spreadsheet"}],"outOfScope":["Editing or deleting a note","Searching links by note","Fixing the stale redirect cache after delete (known issue BF-1)"],"classification":"GREENFIELD"}
